cause_quote: The original picker used `encoded.startsWith("data:image/webp") ? encoded : canvas.toDataURL("image/png")` at a single 96 px size and returned null when `value.length <= AVATAR_EDITOR_MAX_DATA_URL_CHARS` was false.
user_saw: Safari rejected some avatar images well under 2 MB and told users to pick an image file up to 2 MB.
summary: The fix adds a JPEG fallback for opaque avatars, tries smaller PNG encodings when needed, and gives a specific error when the encoded image exceeds the identity storage budget.
reasoning: The introducing diff added the Control UI avatar picker with a single 96 px PNG fallback and routed every encoding rejection to the same 2 MB message. First-parent history shows the encoder stayed unchanged until this fix, and the fix PR documents that WebKit returned PNG for the WebP request and rejected a 635 KB transparent image.
